text:
Sam (Moss Corp): Hey @support — the invoice we received for Feb usage (Inv #R-2026-4521) doesn't have our PO number. Our AP team will hold payment without the PO. Can you reissue an invoice with PO MCP-4501?

Ava Support: Sorry about that — we can help. Can you confirm the invoice number and whether payment was already processed? :thinking_face:

Sam (Moss Corp): Invoice R-2026-4521. PO MCP-4501. Payment hasn't been processed yet — AP won't accept it otherwise.

Jin Billing: Looping in @billing-team. If payment is still outstanding we can do a credit + reissue (preferred). If payment was captured we'd need refund + re-bill which takes longer. @invoice-bot, pull invoice state please.

invoice-bot: Invoice R-2026-4521 — status: outstanding, issued 2026-03-09, amount: $12,430.00 USD, payment_method: card on file (ending ••4242), PO: none.

Ava Support: Great — since it's still outstanding we will: 1) create a credit/void for R-2026-4521, 2) reissue a corrected invoice with the PO metadata. This preserves accounting continuity. Moss — okay to keep the same invoice date/terms on the reissued invoice?

Moss Finance: Yes please reissue with MCP-4501 and keep same invoice/due dates.

Jin Billing: Starting reissue workflow now. Marking ticket as billing-escalation. @finance-notify will confirm when credit is created.

finance-notify: Credit note CN-2026-88 created for R-2026-4521 (amount $12,430.00). Reason: customer requested PO on reissued invoice. :white_check_mark:

Ava Support: Reissuing new invoice with PO MCP-4501 and copying original dates. New invoice R-2026-4521A created. Also added PO field to the org's billing metadata so future invoices include it automatically. New invoice PDF: https://invoices.redwo.od/R-2026-4521A.pdf

Sam (Moss Corp): Got the PDF, PO shows up correctly on the header — looks good. Thanks :thumbsup:

Ava Support: Closing loop. Quick notes for Moss: 1) we updated your org profile to store "po_number" so subsequent invoices will include it automatically, 2) if payment had already been captured we would have needed refund + reissue (3-5 business days). If you want, send over your AP contact email and we'll CC them on the credit + new invoice for faster processing.

Sam (Moss Corp): I'll add the AP email to the org profile now and forward to you. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ava Support: No problem — marking thread resolved. If anything else pops up ping @billing-team.
